findings.detail: Two-digit or slash-date maturity parsing maps multiple 2030/2031 filing maturities to 2020 dates, for example Geo TopCo source maturity 10/15/31 was flagged as 2020-10-15.
Rotation Buyer source maturity is 12/26/31, but the flagged identifier-side value is 2031-12-02.
AI Titan source rows for the S + 4.50 percent position mature 08/29/31, while the flagged identifier text carried 10/30/26.
Artifact Bidco has separate source rows maturing 07/28/31 and 07/26/30, and the flagged rows cross those maturity values between sibling rows.
Aurora Acquireco source rows mature 07/14/31, while the flagged identifier-side value is 2031-07-28 from a neighboring issuer pattern.

rationale: Class 2 row-level adjudication: the filing schedule rows provide explicit maturity cells for the flagged issuers. The raw source confirms the rule fire is not a false alarm: several Agent A identifier-side dates are century/date-token parse errors, and several structured dates or identifier dates are taken from the wrong sibling issuer/instrument row. The source rows above ground the mismatches directly.
